panels.description: This metric shows total request activity in the selected period, including successful and failed attempts. It provides baseline demand context for interpreting quality and performance changes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_requests), 0) as value FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo()) AND s.location IN ($location) AND COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') IN ($server) AND s.proxy_id IN ($phone)

panels.title: Total Requests

panels.description: This metric shows the percentage of requests that completed successfully in the selected period. It is the primary reliability KPI and should be read with traffic volume for proper context.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) as value FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo()) AND s.location IN ($location) AND COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') IN ($server) AND s.proxy_id IN ($phone)

panels.title: Distinct Proxies

panels.description: This metric shows the percentage of requests that completed successfully in the selected period. It is the primary reliability KPI and should be read with traffic volume for proper context.

targets.rawSql: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests, SUM(s.ip_change_count) as ip_change_count, ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) as success_rate_pct FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo()) AND s.location IN ($location) AND COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') IN ($server) AND s.proxy_id IN ($phone) GROUP BY s.day ORDER BY s.day

panels.title: 7-Day Behavior Trend (Requests, IP Changes, Success %)

panels.description: This metric measures request speed, including slow-end latency risk where applicable. Persistent increases signal degrading user experience and should trigger performance triage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') as server_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.proxy_id) as proxies, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests, SUM(s.ip_change_count) as ip_changes, ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) as success_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) as avg_response_ms FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo()) AND s.location IN ($location) AND COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') IN ($server) AND s.proxy_id IN ($phone) GROUP BY COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY ip_changes DESC, total_requests DESC

panels.title: Server Details & Stats (Summary)

panels.description: This metric shows the highest single-period spike reached in the selected range. Use it to size worst-case risk and validate alert thresholds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.proxy_id, COALESCE(MAX(s.device_name), s.proxy_id) as device_name, COALESCE(MAX(s.server_name), 'UNKNOWN') as server_name, COALESCE(MAX(s.location), 'N/A') as location, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests, SUM(s.ip_change_count) as ip_change_count, SUM(s.unique_ips_count) as unique_ips_count, ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) as success_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) as avg_response_ms, MAX(s.first_ip) as first_ip, MAX(s.last_ip) as last_ip, MAX(s.most_used_ip) as most_used_ip, MAX(s.most_used_ip_count) as most_used_ip_count, MAX(CAST(s.ip_history_json AS CHAR)) as ip_history_json FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo()) AND s.location IN ($location) AND COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') IN ($server) AND s.proxy_id IN ($phone) GROUP BY s.proxy_id ORDER BY ip_change_count DESC, total_requests DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Per-Proxy Stats & Changed IP List

panels.description: This metric tracks observed outbound IP-change activity across the selected period. It validates whether rotation behavior is producing real identity movement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.day, s.proxy_id, COALESCE(s.device_name, s.proxy_id) as device_name, COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') as server_name, COALESCE(s.location, 'N/A') as location, s.ip_change_count, s.rotation_count, s.ip_rotation_periodic_success_count, s.ip_rotation_periodic_failure_count, (s.ip_rotation_periodic_success_count + s.ip_rotation_periodic_failure_count) as periodic_rotation_total_count, ROUND(s.ip_rotation_periodic_success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.ip_rotation_periodic_success_count + s.ip_rotation_periodic_failure_count, 0), 2) as periodic_success_rate_pct, s.first_ip, s.last_ip, s.most_used_ip, s.most_used_ip_count, CAST(s.ip_history_json AS CHAR) as ip_history_json FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.day) AND s.location IN ($location) AND COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') IN ($server) AND s.proxy_id IN ($phone) AND s.ip_change_count > 0 ORDER BY s.day DESC, s.proxy_id

panels.title: Daily IP Change Events (Changed IP List)

panels.description: This metric tracks observed outbound IP-change activity across the selected period. It validates whether rotation behavior is producing real identity movement.

targets.rawSql: WITH transitions AS (SELECT s.proxy_id, COALESCE(s.device_name, s.proxy_id) as device_name, COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') as server_name, COALESCE(s.location, 'N/A') as location, j.from_ip, j.to_ip, COUNT(*) as change_events FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s JOIN JSON_TABLE(s.ip_history_json, '$.changes[*]' COLUMNS (from_ip VARCHAR(45) PATH '$.from', to_ip VARCHAR(45) PATH '$.to')) j WHERE $__timeFilter(s.day) AND s.location IN ($location) AND COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN') IN ($server) AND s.proxy_id IN ($phone) GROUP BY s.proxy_id, COALESCE(s.device_name, s.proxy_id), COALESCE(s.server_name, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(s.location, 'N/A'), j.from_ip, j.to_ip), totals AS (SELECT SUM(change_events) as total_events FROM transitions) SELECT t.proxy_id, t.device_name, t.server_name, t.location, t.from_ip, t.to_ip, CONCAT(t.from_ip, ' -> ', t.to_ip) as transition, t.change_events, ROUND(t.change_events * 100.0 / NULLIF(tt.total_events, 0), 2) as share_pct FROM transitions t CROSS JOIN totals tt ORDER BY t.change_events DESC, t.server_name, t.proxy_id LIMIT 200

panels.title: IP Transition Matrix (From -> To)

panels.description: Splits each duplicate-IP capture into within-server collisions (one server label on the IP) versus cross-server collisions (multiple server labels on the IP). The $server filter scopes the universe to IPs that involve at least one selected server, while the within/cross classification still uses the IP's full server set, so an IP shared by S10 + S14 stays cross-server even when only S10 is selected.

targets.rawSql: WITH ip_server_counts AS (SELECT d.captured_at, d.last_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT d.server_label) AS server_count FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers d WHERE $__timeFilter(d.captured_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers sf WHERE sf.captured_at = d.captured_at AND sf.proxy_status_scope = d.proxy_status_scope AND sf.last_ip = d.last_ip AND TRIM(sf.server_label) IN (${server:sqlstring})) GROUP BY d.captured_at, d.last_ip) SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(captured_at) AS time_sec, SUM(CASE WHEN server_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_ips_within_server, SUM(CASE WHEN server_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_ips_across_servers FROM ip_server_counts GROUP BY captured_at ORDER BY captured_at

panels.title: Duplicate IP Trend: Within Server vs Across Servers

panels.description: This panel compares server-level contribution to performance or risk. It helps prioritize interventions where they will deliver the largest improvement.

targets.rawSql: WITH ip_server_counts AS (SELECT s.last_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) as max_server_count FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.captured_at) GROUP BY s.last_ip), classified AS (SELECT CASE WHEN isc.max_server_count = 1 THEN 'Within Single Server' ELSE 'Across Multiple Servers' END as duplicate_type, COUNT(*) as unique_duplicate_ip_count FROM ip_server_counts isc GROUP BY duplicate_type), total AS (SELECT SUM(unique_duplicate_ip_count) as total_unique_duplicates FROM classified) SELECT c.duplicate_type, c.unique_duplicate_ip_count, ROUND(c.unique_duplicate_ip_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_unique_duplicates, 0), 2) as share_pct FROM classified c CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY c.unique_duplicate_ip_count DESC

panels.title: Duplicate Type Split (Selected Time Range)

panels.description: This metric counts how many duplicate-IP captures were taken during the selected period. It confirms data continuity and shows whether trend gaps may come from missing captures.

targets.rawSql: WITH server_span AS (SELECT s.last_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) as server_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.server_label ORDER BY s.server_label SEPARATOR ', ') as server_labels FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.captured_at) GROUP BY s.last_ip), row_agg AS (SELECT r.last_ip, MAX(r.phones_on_same_ip) as max_phones_on_same_ip, ROUND(AVG(r.phones_on_same_ip), 2) as avg_phones_on_same_ip, MIN(r.captured_at) as first_seen_in_range, MAX(r.captured_at) as last_seen_in_range, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(r.captured_at)) as duplicate_days_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(r.captured_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE(r.captured_at) SEPARATOR ', ') as duplicate_dates, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.sibling_phones SEPARATOR ' | ') as sibling_phones, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.device_ids SEPARATOR ' | ') as device_ids FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.captured_at) GROUP BY r.last_ip) SELECT ra.last_ip, CASE WHEN ss.server_count = 1 THEN 'Within Single Server' ELSE 'Across Multiple Servers' END as duplicate_type, ss.server_count, ss.server_labels, ra.max_phones_on_same_ip, ra.avg_phones_on_same_ip, ra.duplicate_days_count, ra.duplicate_dates, ra.first_seen_in_range, ra.last_seen_in_range, ra.sibling_phones, ra.device_ids FROM row_agg ra JOIN server_span ss ON ss.last_ip = ra.last_ip WHERE ra.max_phones_on_same_ip > 1 ORDER BY ss.server_count DESC, ra.max_phones_on_same_ip DESC, ra.last_seen_in_range DESC LIMIT 100
